why: PERFORMANCE-RULES.md §8.1. Per-frame limits on the main canvas, judged at each scenario's worst spot, q0 (canvas 2x CSS). Set by the lead's brief (2026-10-30) and calibrated about 25% over the merged build's numbers so the check passes on ebc13e43.

shadowOrFilter.why: brief: no shadowBlur or filter set in a frame

shrunkOver2_5x.why: brief: a sheet shrunk more than 2.5x at q0 is reported; over 20 per frame fails

blends.why: advanced blends are emulated with a copy on PowerVR (PERFORMANCE-RULES §2.10); the coefficient modes below are cheap

art.why: PERFORMANCE-RULES §8.2: no image over 4096 px on a side. These 13 clip sheets were already over it on 2026-10-30 (sheetBake/creatureAnim bake them smaller once at stage start, but the full sheet is still decoded and uploaded once); they are debts to split, and a new one fails the check.
